description: Awin product-level tracking requests on www.awin1.com/basket.php and zenaps.com/basket.php. Each product_line is one AW:P row. Conversion pixels stay vendor/awin. The MasterTag stays vendor/awin-mastertag.

params.name: product_line
params.description: It is one product-level tracking row. Awin documents `product_line` as `AW:P|{advertiserId}|{orderReference}|{productId}|{productName}|{productItemPrice}|{productQuantity}|{productSku}|{commissionGroupCode}|{productCategory}`. Price is a float with a dot decimal. Quantity is a positive integer. SKU and category may be blank.
